opening.argument: The presentation urges the audience to join cryptocurrency participation as a route to financial freedom, declaring, “Cryptocurrency is the way to set our money free.” It makes that appeal concrete with OneCoin: a friend could invite someone to join, while hesitation means later seeing that friend “with a brand new car.” The speaker then calls on the audience to bring other people into the movement and says, “that's what cryptocurrencies will do for you.” The stage display contrasts governments and banks with a movement that needs participants. Together, these appeals frame participation as a path to material benefit and a more prosperous future, while encouraging viewers to recruit others. This is not neutral market commentary; it promotes cryptocurrency involvement through promised financial advantages and urgency around joining.
